_readme.what: Named lists of structures. group/* tags decide which structures share a group grid (structure_groups.json); every other tag is for grouping, reports and building those lists. Tags have no multipliers any more (2026-09-27: every rate lives in structure_groups.json).
_readme.values: Entries: "ns:id" (one structure), "ns:*" or "ns:prefix_*" (glob, * matches anything including /), "#tag/name" (every member of another tag in this file), and a leading "!" on any of those to exclude (exclusions win, whatever their position). Unknown ids and tags are errors (logged, listed in the report, and NO structure changes are applied until fixed), so a typo never silently does nothing.
_readme.groups: A structure may be in at most one group/* tag. After changing one, run python3 tools/gen_structure_groups.py to give new members a fitted weight and frequency.
_readme.families: mod/* = one tag per namespace (plus mod/yungs for YUNG's 6). type/* = what the structure is; a structure can have more than one type. dungeon/* = dungeons split by location (surface / underground) and origin (vanilla / better = YUNG's / modded). group/* = the shared grids. meta/* = the structures a meta structure may use as its anchor or parts (meta_structures.json); each is also a real structure tag creativeengineering:meta/<name>, added by structure_overrides.js. land and land/* = biome fits (biome_fits.json): a structure in one spawns in that fit's biomes plus its parents' (land/oak: land/oak + land biomes) instead of its own list; each is also a real structure tag creativeengineering:<name>.

mod/villager_buildings.note: 2026-09-27 batch of MCreator one-building mods with villagers (or their animals) inside, all converted to kubejs/data: stables, barns, shops, workshops, churches, temples, watchtowers. Tents and camps are in mod/villager_camps.

mod/villager_camps.note: Friendly tents and camps from the same batch (converted to kubejs/data).

type/village.note: Settlements: vanilla, Towns & Towers, Terralith fortified villages. Also the meta villages: with peaceful towers, and the fortified villages with ruins or camps around them.

type/house.note: Standalone friendly buildings: homes, farms, cook houses, fish farms, the one-building villager house mods and Simply Houses' empty buildings (its "forest fort" is house-sized, not a walled compound). undergardens_sea targets the Undergarden dimension's biomes, so it likely never spawns here.

type/camp.note: Tents and small camps: T&T's camp-form outposts (beach, snowy beach, sparse jungle, wooded badlands), the wandering trader camp village, the friendly villager tents/camps (mod/villager_camps) and the illager siege-weapon camps.

type/castle.note: Castles that are one building (not jigsaw villages, so not type/village: earth-fill pruning cuts village pieces). 2026-10-14.

type/vehicle.note: Carts, wagons and siege weapons (hostile, group/vehicles; 2026-10-14). The siege weapons were in type/camp before.

type/tower.note: Towers in any dimension: the vanilla outpost, T&T's tower-form outposts, Philip's ancient towers, Terralith's spire and sunken tower, MES's enderwatch tower, Hearths' crimson/warped towers.

type/ship.note: Intact ships: T&T's pillager ship and ocean fleet village, MES's starlight voyager (End airship), the antique trading ship, illager warship and longship, Blocky Siege's pillager ship, Unwrecked Ships (ocean + Nether), villager rafts. Wrecks are type/shipwreck. Also the raft convoy and the pillager fleet (meta structures).

type/enemy_building.note: Buildings occupied by hostile mobs: every pillager structure plus witch huts (vanilla, YUNG's, Terralith's cave hut).

type/ruin.note: Overworld land ruins, surface and buried. Ocean ruins are type/underwater_ruin, portals type/ruined_portal. Also the ruin meta structures (a large ruin with small ones, a scatter of small ones).

type/ruined_portal.note: All 7 vanilla ruined portal variants (one shared set, currently disabled in structure_config.json).

type/underwater_ruin.note: Also the sunken ruin cluster (meta structure).

type/shipwreck.note: Revamped Shipwrecks empties minecraft:shipwrecks, so its two jigsaw wrecks stand in for the vanilla shipwreck / shipwreck_beached (same biome tags, which Hopo extends to beaches and rivers). Also the shipwreck meta structures (a wreck with floating wreckage, a shipwreck graveyard).

type/mineshaft.note: Vanilla mineshafts plus Terralith's underground mining outpost.

type/underground.note: Underground structures that are not dungeons (those are dungeon/underground) or mineshafts: Terralith's cave structures, Philip's deep ruins, buried treasure.

type/environmental.note: Overworld natural features rather than buildings. Nether and End ones are type/nether_environmental and type/end_environmental. Also the driftwood flotilla and the deadwood patches (meta structures).

type/decoration.note: Small clutter with no interior, any dimension: way signs, rock piles, obelisks, spikes, pillars, fossils.

type/sky.note: Floating structures: Cloud Storage, Sky Villages and the sky meta structures (2026-10-30).

type/nether_environmental.note: Natural-looking Nether features (checked by template blocks: fossil bone, a netherrack spiral).

type/nether_constructed.note: Built Nether structures. twigs:bloodstone_obelisk is polished bloodstone bricks, so it counts as built.

type/end_environmental.note: Natural-looking End features, checked by template blocks: bone dragon skeleton, meteorite crater, end-stone prairie, enderbloom trees, purpur/amethyst growths.

type/end_constructed.note: Built End structures: end cities, the rest of MES (purpur / end-stone-brick builds), Philip's End ruins and gate fortress, Ender's Delight's End House, Mysticrift's End pillager tower (2026-10-25; type tag only: the tower still takes its slots from group/pillager_settlements, and type/end_constructed is no group, so none of these share a grid).

dungeon/surface_better.note: YUNG's replacements for the vanilla surface dungeons.

dungeon/underground_better.note: YUNG's Better Strongholds and the four Overworld Better Dungeons.

dungeon/surface.note: Above-ground Overworld dungeons (vanilla, better and modded).

dungeon/vanilla.note: Every vanilla dungeon, including Nether, End and ocean ones.

dungeon/better.note: Every YUNG's dungeon, including Better Fortresses and the Nether Better Dungeon.

dungeon/classic.note: Vanilla dungeons and their YUNG's Better versions together.

pillager.note: Every illager structure: the vanilla outpost and mansion, all 29 T&T outposts (camps, forts, towers, ship), Mysticrift's 8 towers, the illager siege-weapon camps, the illager warship and longship, Blocky Siege's pillager ship. Also the pillager meta structures (towers, forts and camps with siege weapons, camps at ruins, the fleet).

ruins.note: Ruins in every dimension: land, underwater, portals, and the Nether/End ruins.

group/settlements.note: Friendly settlements: vanilla and Towns & Towers villages, Terralith fortified villages, and the meta village with peaceful towers. The meteorite-struck village (meta/meteorite_village, any village type) and the sieged villages (meta/village_siege_ring, meta/village_siege_camp) take their slots from the villages here (2026-10-30).

group/pillager_settlements.note: Pillager outposts on land: vanilla, every Towns & Towers tower, fort and camp outpost except the ship (boats), Mysticrift's towers, the illager siege-weapon camps, It Takes a Pillage's camp and bastille (2026-10-12). Also the land pillager meta structures, which take their slots from their anchors here.

group/ruins.note: Surface land ruins: Philip's Ruins, Terralith's glacial hut, Forest Ruins, the abandoned watchtower, the forgotten church, and as rare decoration the old illager and villager statues and the small cat statues (2026-10-12). Underground ruins stay standalone.

group/surface_dungeons.note: Surface dungeons: YUNG's jungle temple, the vanilla jungle temple (in 10% of YUNG's temple slots, "replaces" in structure_groups.json), the woodland mansion, Terralith's spire, the T&T desert mimic, Philip's badlands dungeon. The witch huts and desert temples have their own groups (group/witch_huts, group/desert_temples). The jungle temple with ruins (meta/jungle_temple_ruins) takes its slots from YUNG's jungle temple here (2026-10-30).

group/desert_temples.note: Desert temples: YUNG's desert temple and the vanilla desert pyramid, which takes a share of YUNG's temple slots ("replaces" in structure_groups.json), as does the meteorite-struck pyramid (meta/meteorite_desert_pyramid, a meta without an anchor); meta/desert_temple_ruins takes a share of YUNG's temple slots as its anchor. Own grid with twice the surface dungeons' minimum distance (structures/rates-and-groups #10).

group/witch_huts.note: Witch huts, swamps only (land/swamp): YUNG's witch hut and witch circle, the Villages & Pillages witch village, and the vanilla swamp hut, which takes a share of YUNG's hut slots ("replaces" in structure_groups.json) instead of slots of its own. Own grid, so witch huts no longer compete with the surface dungeons. The witch coven meta takes its slots from the witch circle here (2026-10-30).

group/entrance_dungeons.note: Dungeons with a way in from the surface, land only: YUNG's zombie dungeon (crypt, a staircase up to 20 blocks long from y 50) and spider dungeon (spider cave, y 70). Out of water_ok, and in surface_check so the surface above them must be dry land. YUNG's skeleton and small dungeons stay standalone (closed rooms underground).

group/nether_ruins.note: Nether ruins: Twigs' bloodstone obelisk and Philip's three Nether ruins (Nether dungeon, sealed ghast statue, lava ruins), and since 2026-11-02 the four builds moved from the Overworld except the lost soul city (own set, it is big): lost soul dungeon, rare ruin, blackstone Nether ruin (structures/contents #1). Nether only; ruins stays Overworld-only. Added 2026-10-12.

group/way_signs.note: Supplementaries' way signs on a grid of their own (2026-10-12): the old set's placement (19/10, kept 8 chunks off settlement grid slots), so the rate is unchanged. Each sign points at the nearest #supplementaries:way_sign_destinations, which structure_overrides.js fills with every group/settlements member (villages, fortified villages, meta/village_towers).

group/vehicles.note: Vehicles (hostile, 2026-10-14, plan 7.4.5): the 6 Illager Siege Weapons camps (moved out of pillager_settlements), the pillager loot carriage (with the villager chase and the golem prison van) and the witch wagon. Rarer than camps, more common than outposts, twice as common in harsh biomes (biome_frequency). The witch cart caravan and pillager caravan metas take their slots from the wagon and the loot carriage here (2026-10-30).

group/ocean_ruins.note: Ocean ruins and wrecks: vanilla, Hopo's and Philip's ocean ruins, Philip's ocean fortress, Revamped Shipwrecks (standing in for the vanilla wrecks), the T&T wreckage, Hopo's underwater fossils (2026-10-12).

group/ocean_dungeons.note: Ocean monuments, on the monuments' own grid (same spacing, spread and salt, so positions match vanilla). Monument meta structures join later. The meteorite-struck monument (meta/struck_monument) takes its slots from the monument here (2026-10-30).

group/sky.note: Sky structures: Cloud Storage's hot air balloons and sky temples, Sky Villages, AE2 meteorites, and the sky meta structures (through type/sky: cloud clusters, balloon fleets, clouds with balloons, a sky village with floating islands), which take their slots from their anchors here.

group/boats.note: Ships at sea: the Towns & Towers ship village and pillager ship, the antique trading ship, illager warship and longship, Blocky Siege's pillager ship, Unwrecked Ships' ocean ship, villager rafts. Also the raft convoy and the pillager fleet (meta structures).

group/flotsam.note: Floating debris at sea: the driftwood flotilla (meta structure). Its own grid, so it takes no slots from ruins or ships.

group/deadwood.note: Patches of dead wood on land: stumps and fallen logs by wood type (meta structures). Its own grid, so it takes no slots from buildings or ruins.

group/remote.note: Lone camps and cabins: the T&T wandering trader camp, every single-building house mod in the Overworld and the friendly villager tents/camps, and the fresh watchtower (with the other peaceful towers, 2026-10-12). The two Farmer's Structures houses whose biomes come from mods this pack does not have (Aether, Undergarden) stay out. The trader caravan meta takes its slots from the trader camps here (2026-10-30).

water_ok.note: Structures allowed to start in water biomes (biome_rules.water in structure_groups.json). In the water: ships, wrecks, underwater ruins, the ocean monument, Hopo's underwater fossils, the ocean ruined portal, Farmer's Structures' stilted river sushi stall. Not in the water but fine over it: sky structures and the AE2 meteorite (group/sky), and everything underground (under the seabed). The driftwood flotilla floats on the sea. The entrance dungeons (group/entrance_dungeons) are taken back out: their staircase or cave mouth reaches the surface.

surface_check.note: Structures that start underground but reach the surface: biome_rules.water also checks the noise surface above their start (centre and corners of the start's box) and drops the start if that surface is a water biome or under a fluid (patcherMod StructureBiomeRules).
